title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier with Towel Bar Solid Brass Hardware Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch with Towel Bar
description:
Add organized storage with a wall mount glass shelf featuring three tiers and an integrated towel bar—crafted with solid brass hardware and 3/8-inch tempered glass. Designed for traditional bathroom hardware looks, this shelf keeps daily essentials and display items neatly within reach while saving floor space.

Highlights:
- Triple-tier glass shelf design adds vertical storage and organization
- Integrated towel bar provides a convenient spot for hand towels
- 3/8-inch thick tempered, beveled-edge glass for safety and strength
- Solid brass hardware with concealed screw mounting for a clean finish
- Coordinates with classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Overall dimensions: 16-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 18-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Mounting: Wall mount; concealed hardware included (#8 x 1 1/4" screws)
- Assembly: No assembly required
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
